name: the year-page gate never stops the script
why: Year pages are opt-in (sa_bb_year_pages, default off) on top of sa_enable_brucebase. Without their gate the toolbar appears with only the Brucebase switch on; the spec must see it appear.

name: a 00 day or month is kept in the date
why: 1954-10-00 must become 1954-10, or the shared date splitter names the weekday of 'day 0' (the last day of the month before). The spec pins Date, DD and Day of the 2026-01-00 row and the parser's table.

name: a two-letter code is not read as a state
why: Without the code test every US/Canadian heading's state lands in Country.

name: regions are not taken out of the city
why: SYDNEY, NEW SOUTH WALES, AUSTRALIA would give City 'NEW SOUTH WALES' and Venue 'SYDNEY ENTERTAINMENT CENTRE, SYDNEY'.

name: the type is read from an absolute href's scheme
why: An absolute heading link (https://…/gig:…) once gave Type 'Https'. The live pages write relative links, so only the parser table sees this.

name: an End of box does not clear the tour
why: Entries after 'End of the … tour' would keep the tour's name. The spec pins the rows after the 2026 End box as empty.

name: a combined End of / Start of heading is read as one
why: 'End of the "Castiles" era / Start of the "Earth" era' (1968) would end the tour and never start the next.

name: Continuation of does not start a tour
why: A year that opens mid-tour (1985) says so with 'Continuation of …'; without it the entries before the next box have no tour.

name: set labels are not detached
why: 'Soundcheck:' would stay in the first setlist row and the soundcheck would join the Setlist; 'with Willie Nile:' would get no label.

name: songs are not split on ' / '
why: Each setlist would be one row; the spec pins one song per row.

name: the superscript set note stays in the setlist
why: 'Set details may be inaccurate.' would join the last song's row and leave Set note empty.
grep: set note is its own column

name: a superscript-only paragraph is read as prose
why:
No set details known.

(1968) opens the description instead of being the set note.

name: an italic setlist is read as a note
why: The 2018 Broadway tapings set the whole setlist in one <em>; without the capitals test it becomes prose in Notes.

name: plain-paragraph descriptions are dropped
why: 2,732 of 5,009 entries write their description as plain paragraphs, not a .list-pages-box (1985). The spec pins 1985's Notes text and links.

name: Help Us is shown as a media icon
why: The 'Help Us' icon is Info wanted, not media the gig page has.

name: the media label carries no text
why: The icons are images; their hidden label is what a Media filter (and the dropdown) reads.

name: the entries are left on the page
why: The table must take the entries' place; without the removal every entry shows twice.

name: Load from Disk does not convert the reloaded page
why: After a reload the page holds the entries again; without the hydrate-time call there is no table to render into.

name: copied links are not made absolute
why: Recorded, not caught: on the live page a relative /song: link resolves against the page itself, so every spec reads the same absolute href with or without the rewrite. The rewrite is for a fetched or parsed document (another base), which no year page reaches today.
